rules.duration: Up to 10 minutes; until dispelled at slot 4+

review.access: Normal 2024 Wizard spell-list access; learn and prepare through the Wizard's normal rules.
review.scope: Listed mechanics checked against the official current entry or SRD 5.2.1. Tier and acquisition advice are Compendium editorial judgments, not official rules.

compendium.summary: Multisensory deception for infiltration, diversion and prepared environments. Its 2024 fourth-level-slot breakpoint makes persistent, non-concentration illusions practical much earlier.
warnings: Tier is a situational Compendium assessment, not a letter grade quoted from Pack Tactics.
tactics: At slot 4 or higher it lasts until dispelled without concentration; the concentration badge describes the base third-level casting.
The image cannot itself damage or impose conditions. Physical interaction reveals it, and a successful Study/Investigation check can expose it. Deception is not a physical wall.
Coordinate believable context and the consequence of an enemy believing the image. Illusory Reality is a separate, subclass-gated feature—not a property of ordinary Major Image.
